questions.solution_text:
$s_{1}=\frac{15-0}{1.5-0}$
$=10\text{ km/h}$
$s_{2}=\frac{40-15}{4-2}$
$=\frac{25}{2}$
$=12.5\text{ km/h}$, so the last stage is faster.
